verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a first-party product page, "Ironclad AI", headlined "A New Era of Contract Intelligence", which suggests built-in AI insight features over contract data. The pack only gives page titles, not a description of what the insights or suggestions are. The Workflow API guide on running your own AI-driven analysis is a developer building block, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented description of in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions, details of what data they draw on and how they are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

Built on how contracts really move.
